title: 第21章
content:
看到王大年拿起手中的95式自动步枪一脸爱惜的模样。杨成的表情有些古怪，但还是将那支pf89式火箭筒丢给了那名被王大年抢走了95式自动步枪的士兵。“你也使这个吧。”随后，杨成又将三当家冯元彪给喊了过来。并且将另外一支pf89式火箭筒丢给了冯元彪。“你也给我用这个。”杨成命令道。看着手里黑洞洞的东西，冯元彪的表情和之前的王大年一样。显然，他也只对95式自动步枪感兴趣。对于这个黑洞洞的东西，有些嗤之以鼻。“大哥，我能不能......”“不能”就在冯元彪想要开口的时候，杨成一口回绝。不容冯元彪反驳。看着老三吃瘪的模样，王大年的内心一阵欣喜。黑风寨五虎。老大杨成、老二王大年、老三冯元彪、老四孙太阳、老五刘江海。落草前，杨成是连长，王大年是副连长，冯元彪、孙太阳、刘江海则是杨成手底下的三个排长。孙太阳和刘江海看见老三吃瘪的模样，立马踹起怀中的95式自动步枪，躲杨成躲得远远的。生怕杨成会抢回他们手里的95式自动步枪。然后塞一些稀奇古怪的玩意给他们。看见孙太阳和刘江海躲自己躲得远远的模样。杨成十分无奈。随后，杨成将众人召集起来。带着所有人来到了黑虎堂的大堂外面。手把手地教众人如何用枪。好在，杨成手底下的这些人。都是曾经上过战场的。上手十分之快。很快便掌握了如何使用95式自动步枪。随着他们对枪支的熟练掌握，他们也越发的心惊。不夸张的说，拿着这玩意。一人打掉鬼子一个分队都不是什么问题。杨成在教会所有人如何使用95式自动步枪之后。也是来到了冯元彪以及之前被王大年抢枪的士兵跟前。看着周围学会使用95式自动步枪的其余弟兄一脸振奋的模样。

再看了看朝着他们二人走来的杨成。冯元彪以及另外那个被王大年抢枪的士兵一脸苦涩。“你们和他们不一样。”“压在你们两个身上的担子更重。”“所以，我教你们的时候，你们必须要给我好好看，好好学。”“争取一遍就会。”杨成开口说道。“大当家，我们担子更重？”“就给我们两个这个玩意？”听见了杨成的话，冯元彪一脸的不可置信。他都有些不太相信杨成的话。连一把95式自动步枪都没有分到。还指望他们两个能挑什么重担呢。看着冯元彪疑惑的模样。杨成也没有任何的废话。伸手夺过冯元彪手里的pf89式火箭筒。现在的军武商场，杨成只打开了第一层。能够换到的重武器就只有pf89式火箭筒了。至于炮弹，杨成兑换所有武器最后剩下的积分只能够兑换20枚。战争还未开始。演示学习用的炮弹，能省一枚是一枚。杨成可没有那么多的炮弹供他们两个练习的。“老三，老大都说了，你们两个肩膀上的担子更重。”“我们黑风寨这一仗的关键就靠你们两个了。”“一会打起来，老三你可得照着我一点啊。”就在这个时候，拿到95式自动步枪的王大年对着冯元彪嘲讽道。这话，听在冯元彪的耳朵里。使得冯元彪整个人脸色顿时就难看了起来。“王大年，你给我少说两句，你要再话多，一会的大战你也别参加了，给我去守仓库去。”杨成狠狠地瞪了王大年一眼。自己要教冯元彪如何使用pf89式火箭筒，这可是十分关键的事情。在杨成的计划当中，那前来围剿黑风寨的两支倭军中队。他们的机枪组还就得靠这些pf89式火箭筒来解决。虽然他们现在人手一把95式自动步枪。却并不代表着小鬼子对自己手底下的弟兄就没有威胁。能够靠着这两管pf89式火箭筒的火力压制住对方的机枪组。
content_en:
I saw Wang Danian picking up the Type 95 automatic rifle with a look of care on his face.Yang Cheng's expression was a little strange, but he still threw the PF89 rocket launcher to the soldier whose Type 95 automatic rifle was snatched away by Wang Danian."You can do this too." Then, Yang Cheng called the third leader Feng Yuanbiao over.And threw another PF89 rocket launcher to Feng Yuanbiao."You can use this for me too." Yang Cheng ordered.Looking at the dark thing in his hand, Feng Yuanbiao's expression was the same as Wang Danian's before.Obviously, he is only interested in the Type 95 automatic rifle.I was a little scornful of this black hole thing."Brother, can I..." "No." Just when Feng Yuanbiao wanted to speak, Yang Cheng refused.Feng Yuanbiao was not allowed to refute.Seeing the deflated appearance of the third child, Wang Danian felt happy in his heart.The Five Tigers of Black Wind Village.The eldest is Yang Cheng, the second is Wang Danian, the third is Feng Yuanbiao, the fourth is Sun Taiyang, and the fifth is Liu Jianghai.Before Luocao, Yang Cheng was the company commander, Wang Danian was the deputy company commander, and Feng Yuanbiao, Sun Taiyang, and Liu Jianghai were the three platoon commanders under Yang Cheng.When Sun Taiyang and Liu Jianghai saw the deflated appearance of their third child, they immediately kicked up the Type 95 automatic rifles in their arms and hid far away from Yang Cheng.They were afraid that Yang Cheng would take back the Type 95 automatic rifle in their hands.Then give them some weird stuff.He saw Sun Yangyang and Liu Jianghai hiding away from him.Yang Cheng was very helpless.Later, Yang Cheng gathered everyone together.He took everyone outside the lobby of Black Tiger Hall.Teach everyone step by step how to use a gun.Fortunately, these people are under Yang Cheng's command.All of them have been on the battlefield.Getting started is very fast.He quickly mastered how to use the Type 95 automatic rifle.As they became more proficient with guns, they became more and more frightened.Literally speaking, take this thing.It's not a problem for one person to defeat a Japanese detachment.After Yang Cheng taught everyone how to use the Type 95 automatic rifle.He also came to Feng Yuanbiao and the soldiers whose guns were snatched by Wang Danian before.Looking at the other brothers around who learned to use the Type 95 automatic rifle, they looked excited.

Then he looked at Yang Cheng, who was walking towards the two of them.Feng Yuanbiao and the other soldier whose gun was snatched by Wang Danian looked bitter."You are different from them." "The burden on you two is heavier." "So, when I teach you, you must watch and study hard." "You will get it if you try it once." Yang Cheng said."Master, do we have a heavier burden?" "Just give this thing to the two of us?" After hearing Yang Cheng's words, Feng Yuanbiao looked in disbelief.He didn't quite believe Yang Cheng's words.Not even a Type 95 automatic rifle was assigned.What kind of burden do we expect the two of them to shoulder?Looking at Feng Yuanbiao's confused look.Yang Cheng didn't have any nonsense.He reached out and grabbed the PF89 rocket launcher from Feng Yuanbiao's hand.In the current military mall, Yang Cheng has only opened the first floor.The only heavy weapon that can be exchanged is the PF89 rocket launcher.As for the artillery shells, Yang Cheng could only redeem 20 of his remaining points for all weapons.The war has not yet begun.As for the cannonballs used for demonstration and learning, one can be saved every time.Yang Cheng didn't have that many shells for the two of them to practice with."Third brother, the boss has said that you two have a heavier burden on your shoulders." "The key to our battle in Heifeng Village depends on you two." "When the fight starts, third brother, you have to follow me." At this time, Wang Danian, who had obtained the Type 95 automatic rifle, taunted Feng Yuanbiao.These words fell into Feng Yuanbiao’s ears.Feng Yuanbiao's face suddenly turned ugly."Wang Danian, please stop saying a few words to me. If you keep talking too much, don't participate in the big battle later. Go and guard the warehouse instead." Yang Cheng gave Wang Danian a hard look.He has to teach Feng Yuanbiao how to use the PF89 rocket launcher, which is a very critical thing.In Yang Cheng's plan, the two Japanese army squadrons came to encircle Heifeng Village.Their machine gun team still has to rely on these PF89 rocket launchers.Although they now have a Type 95 automatic rifle.But it doesn't mean that the little devil is not a threat to his brothers.The opponent's machine gun team can be suppressed by the firepower of these two PF89 rocket launchers.
